news.headline: X News: Ansem faces accusations of hidden wallet schemes amid Pump.fun reward talk
news.detail: X news summary (updated ~21:27 Berlin): Bubblemaps said it plans to expose a major KOL for allegedly drawing copy traders to public wallets while selling via hidden side wallets, farming rewards, and bundling tokens. Community speculation centered on trader @blknoiz06 (Ansem), with talk of Pump.fun trading, large shorts, and past paid promos. Unverified accusations from the X news summary, not a primary disclosure; continues earlier Ansem / Pump.fun reward speculation already on the board.

news.detail: Verified @beincrypto (87,615 followers) posted at 20:18 Berlin that India's Enforcement Directorate searched three offices tied to CoinDCX and Delta Exchange over alleged foreign exchange violations, claiming customer rupee deposits were converted into $USDT for offshore routing (text cut off). news.headline: X News: Coinbase opens spot trading for Collector Crypt (CARD)
news.detail: X news summary (updated ~20:10 Berlin): Coinbase opened spot trading for Collector Crypt (CARD) on 6 Nov 2026 after liquidity requirements in supported regions. Native as CARDS on Solana, it tokenizes graded physical trading cards into redeemable NFTs (gacha packs, trade, or redeem vaulted cards); platform cited at $433.5M Q3 sales. Auction mode for 10 minutes then full orders; availability varies by jurisdiction. Figures and details are from the X news summary.

news.headline: X News: Speculation that Ansem may have a Pump.fun deal
news.detail: X news summary (updated ~20:11 Berlin): Claims circulate that trader @blknoiz06 (Ansem) cut a deal with Pump.fun, citing boosts of low-follower accounts that then post pro-platform content. Tied to Pump.fun callout USDC rewards and talk around $ANSEM sliding from about $0.40 peak to $0.05. Unverified speculation from the X news summary, not a primary disclosure.

news.headline: X News: Solana Labs launches Leap mobile trading app (stocks, crypto, memecoins)
news.detail: X news summary (updated earlier today, still current): Solana Labs launched Leap, an iPhone app for trading tokenized stocks, ETFs, commodities, currencies, crypto, and memecoins on Solana with onchain trades and no platform fees for now. Built by the Dialect team after acquisition; plans to burn SOL from future fees. Early iPhone access via TestFlight; Android later; U.S. users can't trade tokenized stocks. Details from the X news summary.

news.headline: X News: Trader Ansem cites large Pump.fun callout rewards on a SOL short
news.detail: X news summary (updated ~19:44 Berlin): trader @blknoiz06 (Ansem) shared a ~1M SOL short that reportedly netted about $60K in trading profit plus roughly $35K–$36K in Pump.fun Callout Rewards USDC for posting the call publicly, with annualized rewards framed near $12.6M in screenshots circulating in the story. news.headline: The Fallen Hero (BSC) hit ~5.1x about an hour after the launch note
news.detail: Signal account @bitecong (38,530 followers) posted a 1-hour update quoting its earlier launch note: CA 0xe451b966aa64bee4046cfcb0db5fe6aa9f647777. It says the token peaked at about 5.1x (~55 minutes after the note) and was trading around 4.1x at update time, with market cap cited as up from $35.4K at the note to $360.1K, and 511 buys vs 448 sells in the window described.

news.headline: X News: World Liberty Financial launches WLFI token buyback program
news.detail: X news summary: World Liberty Financial announced a buyback plan for its $WLFI governance token, potentially funded by fees from its $USD1 stablecoin reserves, aiming to strengthen the ecosystem and boost long-term holder voting power. Timing follows a ~10% WLFI drop since recent U.S. midterms and a larger year-to-date decline; amounts and schedule still early-stage.
